mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS registrationId, r.event_id AS eventId, e.title AS eventTitle, e.category AS category, e.location AS location, e.start_time AS eventStartTime, e.end_time AS eventEndTime, r.status AS status, r.registered_at AS registeredAt FROM registration r INNER JOIN event e ON e.id = r.event_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.registered_at DESC

SELECT e.id AS eventId, e.title AS eventTitle, e.capacity AS capacity, e.available_slots AS availableSlots, COUNT(r.id) AS totalRegistrationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('REGISTERED','CHECKED_IN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeRegistrationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkedInCount, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CHECKED_IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('REGISTERED','CHECKED_IN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) , 4) AS checkInRate FROM event e LEFT JOIN registration r ON r.event_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.title, e.capacity, e.available_slots
